source: ngspice ideal full-bridge RLC deck, 50 ns maximum timestep, one rectified 60 Hz half-cycle
time_s: Linear interpolation to v(drv)=0 at each commanded diagonal transition.
bus_voltage_v: Instantaneous rectified 60 Hz line bus from VRMS and event time.
inductive_sign: Round-3 sign screen: negative tank current on rising drive or positive on falling drive.
tank_current_before_500ns_a: Ideal-drive tank current 500 ns before crossing, interpolated from the saved waveform.
tank_current_after_500ns_a: Ideal-drive tank current 500 ns after crossing, interpolated from the saved waveform; the model switches drive immediately and does not model floating dead time.
tank_current_slope_a_per_s: Local slope across ngspice samples bracketing the ideal-drive crossing; diagnostic only.
minimum_zvs_current_a: Blank until a qualified A1 threshold is available.
zvs_verdict: PENDING_A1; no physical dead-time reversal or diode-loss conclusion is encoded.
waveform_archive: outputs/runs/<ceiling>a/<run_id>/waves.raw.gz for every accepted case; ASCII ngspice raw waveform, gzip-compressed. The exact run deck, params, logs and result.json are adjacent.
excluded_cases: needs_burst_or_phase_shift rows have no accepted frequency-only switching events or R5 waveform. Their 60 kHz data is diagnostic.
